title: Vehicle, Mecha & Starship Engineering Adapter Pack
objective: Implement one engineering adapter surface for Vehicle, Mecha and Starship over the existing PPIA-04/MIB-14/F014 owner family, with target-specific profile packs preserving distinct owner rules, identity, configuration, systems, resources, damage, repair and provenance without creating three independent engineering engines or inferring compatibility from names or visual similarity.
acceptance: Vehicle, Mecha and Starship engineering share one MERA adapter substrate while retaining target-specific owner profiles.
PPIA-04/MIB-14/F014 owner identity, configuration, system, resource, damage, repair and provenance state remains authoritative.
Target-specific engineering behavior comes only from explicit owner/profile definitions.
Same names or visual similarity cannot create compatibility or interchangeability.
Unknown or conflicting compatibility and owner state remains unresolved for operations that require it.
MERA predecessor inspection/proposal/diagnostic/repair/network affordances compose without changing owner boundaries.
Blocking vehicle/mecha/starship engineering remains semantic/nonvisual and provider-off.
boundaries: PPIA-04/MIB-14/F014 retain Vehicle/Mecha/Starship identity, configuration, system, resource, damage, repair and live-operation authority.
Distinct Vehicle, Mecha and Starship rules remain in their owner definitions; MERA supplies adapters, not replacement engines.
MERA creates no second Vehicle, Mecha, Starship, inventory, crafting, resource or provenance ledger.
Compatibility and interchangeability remain explicit-definition driven; names and visual similarity confer no authority.
MERA-16+ machinery/robotics/construct/industrial adapter work remains unauthorized.
MBES remains blocked until MERA completes at MERA-24.
next_action: On the next owner Continue, start only MERA-13. Preload the sealed MERA predecessors, PPIA-04/MIB-14/F014 Vehicle/Mecha/Starship owner seams, explicit target-specific profiles, compatibility rules, owner-version semantics and provider-off accessibility boundaries.
